guidelines.guidance: Fictional brand. Use only supplied brief facts. Keep language warm and observant. Do not state prices, nutrition, certifications, delivery dates, testimonials, or any unknown facts.

brief.title: Morrow Orchard autumn fruit box waitlist
brief.objective: Create three content items that invite home cooks in the fictional Alder Vale service area to join a fictional waitlist for Morrow Orchard’s autumn fruit box. The goal is waitlist interest; no purchase or delivery is promised.
brief.key_message: An autumn fruit box brings seasonal variety and simple recipe inspiration to the kitchen. Interested home cooks can join the fictional waitlist to hear more.
brief.content_type: Three distinct content items: an Instagram carousel, an Instagram caption, and a Website waitlist section
brief.restrictions: Do not claim or imply a price, discount, nutritional benefit, certification, delivery date, shipping coverage, customer testimonial, stock level, exact fruit varieties, or any other unknown fact. Do not invent proof, quotes, or guarantees. Use a waitlist call to action only.
brief.target_audience: Home cooks in the fictional Alder Vale service area who enjoy using seasonal fruit in everyday recipes. Do not infer demographics, income, or dietary needs.
brief.target_timeline: Fictional autumn campaign; no publication or delivery date is confirmed
brief.additional_context: Morrow Orchard and Alder Vale are fictional. Available visual source categories for later human review: fruit close-ups, packing scenes, and recipe-card imagery. No actual media assets or rights are supplied. Keep each of the three items distinct and grounded in the stated brief. If a detail is unspecified, omit it or label it as an open question.
